title: Hearty Herbal Croatian Bok Choi Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy Croatian dish featuring bok choi, herbs, and a molten cheese sauce, all grilled to perfection on a robata grill. This egg-free friendly dish is sure to be a crowd pleaser.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, parsley, dill, salt, and pepper.
Add the bok choi to the bowl and toss to coat with the herb mixture.
Thread the bok choi onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 5 minutes per side, or until the bok choi is tender.
In a small saucepan, heat the feta cheese over low heat until melted and smooth.
Stir in lemon juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the grilled bok choi skewers with the molten feta cheese sauce.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill if desired.
